summary: Obsessed with a lover who fills every thought, the singer can't stop thinking about them and feels crazy.
Pleading for one more goodnight kiss while worrying the relationship is slipping away.
A boastful player brags about money, luxury cars, clubs and the women drawn to his style.
Heartbroken after a lover left, the singer aches with memories and wishes for their return.
A tribute to his mother for raising him through hardship, with apologies for his past and promises of gratitude.
Reassures a hurting partner that they are not alone and asks them to hold on through hard times.
A boastful party anthem where the rapper brags about his skill and gets the crowd moving.
An upbeat chant about the rhythm of the night and of life, built on a repeated refrain about love.
Invites a troubled, lonely lover to come to him when life feels wrong and they are in despair.
Furious at injustice, lies and public pressure, the singers demand to be left alone and want to scream.
A horny, repetitive R&B pitch about wanting a lover's body and thinking about nothing but them.
Jokingly wishes for height, a flashy car and a girlfriend, lamenting his awkward luck in his neighborhood.
A plea that love is all we have, set against war, hate, greed and the divisions that tear people apart.
Walks through a crowded street carnival of wealth and poverty, questioning whether he has been blind to it.
A drifting, weary lament about being misunderstood, passing time with a joint and a ride down the road.
Begs a former partner to come back, apologizing for everything and admitting he still wants them back for good.
A confident dance-floor challenge telling a suitor he has to work hard and beg for her attention.
Asks a new love interest whether he wants her, promising time, loyalty and making it good for him.
A lovesick hook insisting a lover was made for him, mixed with a rapper's boasts about women, cars and rivals.
A playful challenge in a romantic hide-and-seek, insisting on playing by the singer's own rules.
An upbeat dance-pop call for a lover to come and take what is offered, repeated in a catchy hook.
Blames himself for a failed relationship, admitting he was a fool, cried over it and still denies it is love.
A boastful crew anthem bragging about crime, guns, money, luxury cars and women, built on call-and-response.
Rappers boast about their flow, party with the crowd and nod to hip-hop history in a playful call-and-response.
Declares wanting to see and love a partner every day of the week and thinking of them constantly.
Cherishes a quiet moment with a partner against a storm, treating these days as the sweetest they will know.
A mocking, repetitive chant that rejects a man for being small, full of crude jokes and profanity.
Lonely and brokenhearted after a breakup, the singer insists life is not over and that she can start again.
Reflects on a love that has lost its words, once haunted by desire, despair and inner monsters.
Remembers how a former partner once loved them and mourns how that love has gone away.
A smitten singer admits he thinks about a girl constantly and longs to be with her.
Addresses a famous star who is adored, exploited and idolised like a saviour, craving attention and love.
Asks a lover for all her loving, promising to give her attention in every way and build a closer bond.
Dreams of leaving street hustling behind for a luxury life of yachts, champagne and far-off beaches.
Looks back at an empty home after a split, admitting that living together was good even though it ended.
Describes a sensual, obsessive affair with a woman he met in Philly and craves more of her.
An energetic dance anthem celebrating percussion and urging listeners to move their feet to the beat.
Cuts off a cruel former lover, refusing to talk until they change their ways and treat her right.
Celebrates the first of the month, when checks arrive, with smoking, drinking and street dealing.
Insists no one can love or want a lover the way she does, jealously questioning a rival's hold on them.
Devoted to a partner, promising to live for them, stand by their side and never be apart.
Dreams of a lost love still in his arms, admitting he loves her though he must let go.
A chorus-driven tale of a charming stranger who arrives in town, leaves broken hearts and ruins marriages.
Thanks someone who never turned away through hard times and helped the singer survive rough years.
Promises to stand by a hurting partner through their darkest hours and never let anyone hurt them.
Misses his mother deeply, remembering her strength and shared Sunday breakfasts while he holds on alone.
A boastful rap about being the baddest new rapper, with crude talk, weed and party energy.
Thanks a loyal best friend who has always been there through good and bad times.
Sardonically imagines a company that profits from making misery, mocking drama, greed and people wanting out.
Insists the singer can't stop loving a partner no matter what, begging them to hold on.
